remainingIssues.description: The bottle image (image-18, 186×186) is horizontally centered in the 285px card (left ≈ 49.5px), but in Figma the image sits at x=780 within the card at x=742, i.e. 38px from the card's left edge — an 11.5px horizontal offset.
remainingIssues.fix: In the ≥1200px block, change `.amz-deal-card--bottle .deal-img` to `justify-content: flex-start` and add `padding-left: 38px` (or `margin-left: 38px` on the img) so the image left edge sits 38px from the card edge.

remainingIssues.description: Rows are centered with a uniform 16px gap, but Figma row 2 uses a 27px gap between 'pC & video games' and 'electronics' (x: 497→524) and starts at x=236 (generated ≈ x=262, 26px off); row 3 uses a 23px gap between 'Home & garden' and 'best sellers' (x: 740→763). Row 1 matches exactly.
remainingIssues.fix: At ≥1200px add per-row gap overrides: `.pill-row:nth-of-type(2) .amz-pill:nth-child(2) { margin-left: 11px; }` (27px total) and `.pill-row:nth-of-type(3) .amz-pill:nth-child(3) { margin-left: 7px; }` (23px total) so row 2 spans 236→1163 as in Figma.

remainingIssues.description: All `.explore-grad` overlays use `#57575700 0% → #1b1b1b 80%`, but Figma specifies the mid ('Gaming Accesories', 51:12) and right ('Outdoor Tools', 51:13) bottom tiles with the #1b1b1b stop at 60%, producing a stronger scrim than currently rendered on those two tiles.
remainingIssues.fix: Add a modifier (e.g. `.explore-card--showcase .explore-grad, .explore-col:last-child .explore-card--compact .explore-grad { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--fig-color-c-57575700) 0%, var(--fig-color-c-1b1b1b) 60%); }`).
